b01-toss.chapter: II · A Coin in Each Tent
b01-toss.note: A man alone at his tent's mouth tosses a coin high off his thumb. People and the coin are added in the image pass.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic late-afternoon photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Keep its landforms and props where they are, but none of its smooth surfaces survive: blob trees become real Aleppo pines and tall cypresses, smooth ground becomes real limestone, scree, scrub and dry grass. Shields are plain round bronze, no emblem. One small bleached-linen tent on a hillside clearing, its shield leaning beside it, a chest and a wicker basket by the tent. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its mercenary's dress exactly (oxblood red tunic and cloak, linen corslet, bronze greaves), its tent and its coin. He stands alone at the tent's mouth, arm raised, a single silver coin clearly visible in the air just above his open hand, glinting; no thumbs-up. No other people, no fire. Deep focus. Nothing modern.
